situation: Two old friends who have always disagreed about politics, texting while the news is on.
topic: Immigration: they are angry with each other, each calling the other's view heartless or naive, and neither backs down.

text: You still doing sal's bday lunch or is that off
Still on. The 12th at the bay place, she wants the outside tables
Yeah fine. Ill book it when im done on the job
Can we do 1pm not 12:30. I've got council people till 12
Ok 1pm
Ta
You watching the news tonight. Immigration thing is on at 6
I know im not a hermit
Just didnt know if you'd see it
Im watching it now
Did you see the bit with the minister. "were just being sensible"
I saw it. The bit with the family in the room, kids on the floor
Thats sensible to you?
I didnt say that. I said we need to know who's coming in and the system's a joke
Half of them arent going home either way and everyone pretends they are
So kids on the floor is the price of knowing who's in the country
Nobody said kids on the floor. Dont put words in my mouth
You said sensible about the kids on the floor
Ok so im heartless now
Didnt say heartless. Said naive. You think you can run it like a switchboard
And you think you can open the door and hope for the best. Mates cousin got done over by a bloke who overstayed. Not a happy story
I've got three clients waiting six years for a decision. One of them is a nurse. If you want to talk about overstaying, talk about the backlog
The backlog is a stuffed system. I agree with that. Dont use it to say I dont care
I didnt say you dont care
We've done this every time the news comes on since uni
And nobody has changed their mind once
You haven't. Im not the one who gets to say about me
Sorry. Not trying to fight tonight
Ok
The nurse is a good one btw. She's on the wards at westmead
Fair enough
1pm sat 12th still fine?
Yes
Westmead nurse. Was that the six year one
Yeah. Got the call last night. Approved
Six years. She cried on the phone then apologised for crying
Thats good. Genuinely
Tell her congrats from me
Will do
Job ran late. 1940s terrace, ceiling full of surprises
Council knocked back the dog park on the reserve. 4 hrs of people yelling
Sorry. Thought you'd have been on the other side of that
I was. Didnt go my way
Hope you got fed
Ate a sad sandwich standing up
Booked the bay place. They had the outside tables so thats sorted
Ta. Ill sort the cake
Passed on your congrats to the nurse. She asked who Greg was. I said the one who argues about everything
Good. Tell her no hard feelings about the rest of it
Ha. She's a nurse, she's heard worse
Done. Owner asked for a second powerpoint in the laundry. Said yes so they dont call me back
Good call
Is the news on again tonight or is that tomorrow
Not watching tonight. Going to eat something that isnt a sandwich
Ok. Bed at 9 for me like a pensioner
Thats the most exciting thing youve said all week
